title: Bring the msnodesqlv8 integration suite in line with the tedious suite
summary: The shared integration tests in `test/common/tests.js` are registered per driver, in `test/tedious/tedious.js` and `test/msnodesqlv8/msnodesqlv8.js`. The two suites have drifted: 9 tests that tedious runs are not registered for msnodesqlv8 at all, either as a run or as an `it.skip` with a reason. A suite that silently omits a test looks green whether or not the driver supports the behaviour. Found while mirroring the `max`-length tests in #1907. That PR registers its three tests in both suites; the remaining gaps are below. ## Goal Every test registered in one suite is either registered in the other, or present as `it.skip('… (not supported by )')` with the reason, matching the existing convention (e.g. `query with raiseerror`, `timeout`, `network error`). ## Gaps These classifications come from reading the test bodies only; none has been run on msnodesqlv8 yet. msnodesqlv8 only runs in Windows CI, so each needs a CI run to confirm. **Probably portable as written (node-mssql logic or server behaviour):** - `bulk insert with length option as string other than max throws`: asserts the server's `Incorrect syntax near 'random'.` from the `CREATE TABLE` that node-mssql emits; msnodesqlv8 runs the same `table.declare()`. - `bulk load with varchar-max field`: `length: Infinity` on a created table. - `query with duplicate output column names`: msnodesqlv8 already runs the stored-procedure, prepared-statement and streaming variants, but not the plain query one. **Need checking against msnodesqlv8 behaviour:** - `transaction with error`: tedious runs it as `(XACT_ABORT set to ON)` with `abortTransactionOnError: true` in its basic suite. Check whether msnodesqlv8 honours that option. - `transaction with synchronous error`: an out-of-range `TinyInt` input. Depends on whether msnodesqlv8 rejects it before sending. - `bulk load releases the connection when the driver rejects its options`: relies on tedious rejecting an invalid `order` direction inside `newBulkLoad`
